Meta.title: MentorMe.lv — find someone who knows
Meta.description: Latvia's directory of knowledge and skills. Kokle, mathematics, jam-making, coaching or renovation — find the person who knows it and is ready to teach. Filter by field, place and format.

Hero.subline: Kokle, mathematics, jam or business — someone in Latvia knows it and is ready to teach you.

Filters.searchPlaceholder: What do you want to learn? For example: kokle, maths, jam
Filters.resultCount: {count, plural, =0 {No one matches} one {# person} other {# people}}
Filters.budgetHint: People who haven't stated a price stay in the list.
Filters.searchResets: Search cleared the filters. You can narrow the results again.

Coaches.sectionLead: Certified professionals, practitioners, craftspeople and people with life experience. All in one list, by the same logic.
Coaches.reviews: {count, plural, =0 {no reviews} one {# review} other {# reviews}}
Coaches.empty: Nothing matches these filters. Try widening your search.
Coaches.emptyAll: No profiles here yet. If you have knowledge — you could be the first.

HowItWorks.title: How it works
HowItWorks.step1Body: Choose the field, the place and whether you want to learn in person or through a screen. The list narrows to those who actually fit.
HowItWorks.step2Body: Read the description, look at the photos and at what the person reads and listens to. The match matters.
HowItWorks.step3Body: Write to them directly — WhatsApp or email. No forms, no waiting.

ForCoaches.title: You have knowledge. Someone is looking for it.
ForCoaches.lead: It doesn't matter whether you have a diploma, a certificate or fifty years of experience in a cellar full of preserves. What matters is whether you have knowledge someone else wants.
ForCoaches.point1Body: Photo, description, what you teach, where and for how much. Five minutes.
ForCoaches.point2Body: We check them manually. The verified badge can't be bought.
ForCoaches.point3Body: They write to you directly. We take no commission.

Footer.tagline: Latvia's directory of knowledge and skills.

Coach.notFoundBody: The person may have removed it, or the link is wrong.
Coach.noCalendly: This person hasn't added a calendar yet

Culture.title: Culture match
Culture.lead: What this person reads, watches and listens to. Sometimes that says more than a certificate.

Reviews.title: Reviews
Reviews.empty: No reviews yet. If you've worked with this person — yours would be the first.
Reviews.formPlaceholder: What did you work on and what changed?
Reviews.loginPrompt: Only account holders can leave reviews — that's how we keep made-up reviews out.
Reviews.loginCta: Sign in to leave a review
Reviews.ownProfile: You can't review your own profile.
Reviews.anonymousHint: Your name won't be visible to any visitor. An honest review matters more than a signature.
Reviews.permanentNote: Once published, only an administrator can delete a review.

Auth.loginLead: No password. Choose an account to sign in with.
Auth.loginLeadReview: You need an account to leave a review. You can stay anonymous — you'll choose that afterwards.
Auth.loginLeadCoach: One more step and you can start filling in your profile.
Auth.whyBody: An account is needed for only two things: people with knowledge who publish a profile, and people who leave a review. Searching and reading is free, no account needed.
Auth.errorBody: The link had expired or sign-in was cancelled. Please try again.

Contact.dialogLeadOpen: Choose where to write. The conversation happens there — {name} will see it right away, even without opening MentorMe.
Contact.loginTitle: Contacts are visible to registered users
Contact.loginBody: We hide contacts so that phone numbers and emails don't end up on spam lists. Signing in takes seconds.
Contact.noContacts: {name} hasn't added any way to get in touch yet.

Blog.title: Articles
Blog.metaDescription: Teachers, masters and coaches write about what they know themselves. Practical articles from people who do it every day.
Blog.lead: The people who teach here write about what they know themselves. No theory from books.
Blog.empty: No articles yet. If you have something to tell — yours would be the first.
Blog.notFoundBody: The author may have removed it, or the link is wrong.

Dashboard.title: My profile
Dashboard.stubBody: Here you can add a photo, description, price, certificates and a calendar link.

Editor.title: My profile
Editor.lead: Fill it in, save, publish. Nobody sees a draft.
Editor.taglineHint: One line people see on your card. Who you help and with what.
Editor.bioHint: An empty line between paragraphs starts a new paragraph.
Editor.avatarHint: JPG, PNG or WebP. Up to 2 MB.
Editor.certProofHint: JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF. Up to 10 MB. Only an administrator sees this — it never appears on your public profile.
Editor.priceHint: Leave empty if you don't want to show a figure.
Editor.nichesHint: Choose up to four fields you actually work in.
Editor.calendlyHint: Full https:// link. People will book directly in your calendar.
Editor.galleryHint: Up to 12 photos. JPG, PNG or WebP, each up to 5 MB.
Editor.cultureHint: Optional, but it helps people see whether you'll click. Each entry can be hidden without deleting it.
Editor.publishHint: A published profile appears in the list and can be found on Google.
Editor.publishBlocked: To publish, fix the fields marked with an error.
Editor.uploadTooLarge: File too large. Limit is {limitMb} MB.
Editor.slugHint: This link leads to your profile. If you change it, the old link stops working — better to settle it now and leave it alone.
Editor.slugTaken: That address is taken. Choose another.
Editor.contactsHint: Only registered users see these contacts. They are never handed to anonymous visitors — not even in the page source.
Editor.consentLabel: I agree that these contacts are shown to registered MentorMe.lv users
Editor.consentHint: Without this we show them to nobody. You can withdraw consent at any time by unticking the box.
Editor.consentRequired: To make contacts visible, confirm your consent.
Editor.needContactToPublish: To publish, add at least one way to reach you or a calendar link — otherwise nobody can contact you.
Editor.cityHint: For example, Talsi or Roja. Optional, but it helps people nearby find you.
Editor.regionHint: If you only teach online, the region is optional.
Editor.forTouristsHint: Masterclasses that can be bought as an experience — smoking food, weaving wreaths, folk dancing. They appear in a separate section.

Account.deleteBody: Your profile, contacts, photos, articles and the reviews you've received will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
Account.deleteError: Couldn't delete the account. Please try again.

PostEditor.listLead: Write about what you know. Articles appear in the shared blog with your name and a link to your profile.
PostEditor.empty: You haven't written any articles yet.
PostEditor.title: Title
PostEditor.titleHint: From 5 to 140 characters. It also becomes the link.
PostEditor.slugHint: Changing it after publishing breaks the old link.
PostEditor.excerptHint: Google and the article card show this. Leave it empty and we'll take the first lines.
PostEditor.contentHint: Markdown: ## heading, **bold**, - list, [link](https://…). Links to your own site are fine.
PostEditor.slugTaken: That link is taken. Choose another.
PostEditor.errTitle: The title must be 5 to 140 characters.
PostEditor.errSlug: Only lowercase letters without diacritics, digits and hyphens.
PostEditor.dailyLimit: One article per day. You can publish the next one tomorrow.
